strategies.label: Advanced
strategies.description: Chooses bet sizes by expected value against your estimated range, reads checks as weakness, and adapts fully to observed tendencies. The table's hardest level.

strategies.label: Advanced, fixed
strategies.description: Advanced without adaptation. Same strategy with adaptation switched off, so it plays every hand the same way.

strategies.label: Intermediate
strategies.description: Estimates your range from your actions and compares its equity with pot odds; adapts at half strength.

strategies.label: Intermediate, fixed
strategies.description: Intermediate without adaptation. Same strategy with adaptation switched off, so it plays every hand the same way.

strategies.label: Beginner
strategies.description: Plays its own cards: equity against any two hands, limps a lot, pays off big bets and seldom bluffs. Does not adapt.

strategies.label: v0.1 bot
strategies.description: PokerLab's first opponent: hand-strength thresholds with occasional bluffs.

strategies.label: Maniac
strategies.description: Plays most hands, bets and raises far too often, rarely folds.

strategies.label: Calling station
strategies.description: Calls almost everything, seldom bets or raises.

strategies.label: Rock
strategies.description: Plays tight and folds to most bets unless it holds a strong hand.

strategies.label: Random
strategies.description: Picks uniformly among its legal actions, with a random raise size. A floor every strategy should beat.
